drawing.title: Historic England · Руководство по полевой документации
drawing.passage: Modules 6–7 cover scale drawings, grid, north arrow, recording levels, establishing section datum and photographic references; module 3 covers recording samples and excavation method.

erimi.title: Cahiers du Centre d’Études Chypriotes · Оставленные предметы Эримы
erimi.passage: Paragraph 14 identifies a quern and broken pithos as primary refuse; notes 22–23 distinguish discard at place of use and removal elsewhere; paragraph 5 notes quern reused in a wall.

met.title: Метрополитен-музей · Изготовление аттических ваз
met.passage: Describes painting methods, clay coatings, firing in three stages and assembly.

stamp.title: Служба национальных парков США · Керамика тимукуа
stamp.passage: Discusses stamped, incised and other surface treatments; stamped pattern produced by pressing a carved paddle into clay.

aerial.title: Historic England · Аэросъёмка Саут-Даунса к северу от Брайтона
aerial.passage: The project analyzed archival aerial photos. RAF vertical runs from 1940s/1950s show prehistoric or Roman field systems before modern ploughing degraded them.

nile.title: Чикагский университет · Древний рукав Нила Ахрамат
nile.passage: Ghoneim et al. used Sentinel-1 satellite radar data, geophysics and deep cores. Radar data reveals inlets linking to the Ahramat Branch; sediment from cores provides supporting evidence.

drone.title: Historic England · Беспилотная съёмка аббатства Торнтон
drone.passage: Thornton Abbey field test used octocopter with digital camera and at least 80% front and 60% lateral overlap; paper plates pinned to ground worked as targets.

blue.title: Университет Северной Флориды · Тепловая съёмка поселения Блу-Джей
blue.passage: Primary study’s abstract reports that a thermal infrared survey revealed unrecorded subsurface architecture and helped map habitation sites. The paper specifies long-wave infrared (LWIR) as a keyword and the published introduction describes the thermal IR wavelengths used in aerial thermography.

metal.title: Австрийская академия наук · Мастерские Чукуричи-Хююка
metal.passage: Horejs and Mehofer, pp. 168–169: furnaces and surrounding working zones identify workshops; excavated equipment includes crucibles, molds, anvils and intermediate products.

brick.title: Geoarchaeology · Сырцовый кирпич Ашдод-Яма
brick.passage: Section 4.1 finds overlapping range from fortification and Building 5175, width 35 cm, varying length and height, and lateral striations from wooden molds. It also documents at least five plastering layers and mud mortar.

bead.title: Хараппский архив · Раскопки Чанху-Даро в 1935–1936 годах
bead.passage: Original field report notes long carnelian/agate beads recovered in different stages, drilled from both ends with stone drills and polished.

beadStudy.title: К. К. Бхан · Технология производства длинных сердоликовых бус
beadStudy.passage: Technical reconstruction suggests heating, knapping, grinding, specialized drilling and polishing; observes well-developed skill in comparison to Khambhat.

amphora.title: Antiquity · Распространение амфор в западных римских провинциях
amphora.passage: Lines 658–664 identify Dressel 20 from Baetica in Britain, Germaniae and Rome (Monte Testaccio) and report reduction in production beginning late second century.

kilns.title: Барселонский университет · Мастерские амфор в римской Бетике
kilns.passage: Research uses kiln debris, potters' stamps, firing supports and discarded wasters to identify workshop sites and measure manufacturing trends.

vag.title: Университет Шеффилда · Керамика римского Ваньяри
vag.passage: Roof tile manufacture was local, documented by kilns and wasters; imported storage vessels were distinguished from tiles by mineral and chemical evidence.
